The fix in numpy_tag.hpp complex_type comparison removes the (ra == ra && rb != rb) and (ra != ra && rb == rb) clauses from the ra>rb and ra<rb branches and changes the final fallthrough from 'return ra != ra' to 'return rb != rb'.

Ordering rule: if both real parts are non-NaN, compare real parts then imaginary; if exactly one real is NaN, the branch that pushes the NaN-real element to the right applies; if both reals are NaN, tie-break by float-like comparison of imaginary parts.
